same_seed_rerun.note: direct-32 is itself the same-seed full re-run without a noise file: the D-012 workaround when seed reproducibility holds. A plain same-seed Draft would share the Engine's own noise with it and needs no noise probe; its Final costs this run

timing.notes: draft_seconds excludes noise_probe_seconds: the probe is harness work to learn the Semantic token count so the Draft's noise can be supplied as a file, not part of rendering a Draft; a plain same-seed Draft costs draft_seconds

final_vs_direct.note: the Final was synthesized with the Draft's saved noise file, written by the harness; direct-32 used the Engine's own noise from the seed, which the Engine does not export and which differs from that file, so the two differ from synthesis on. This is not a reproducibility failure: see draft_to_final.fallback.same_seed_rerun
